termination_notice_period.value: Written notice of termination at least 30 days before the effective date (10 days for failure to pay the Initial Franchise Fee or an installment, or failure to timely enter agency management system information), and you may avoid termination by cure within that period or such longer period as applicable law may require; for the events in Section 17.1 all rights terminate automatically without notice; for the events in Section 17.2 termination is effective immediately upon written notice without an opportunity to cure.
evidence: we may terminate this Agreement by giving you written notice of termination (in the manner provided under Section 24 below) stating the nature of the default at least thirty (30) days before the effective date of termination

(or ten (10) days before the effective date of termination for (i) any failure to pay the Initial Franchise Fee or an installment thereof, or (ii) any failure to timely enter information into the agency management system as required by the Manual).

You may, however, avoid termination by: (a) immediately initiating a remedy to cure such default; (b) curing the default to our satisfaction; and (c) promptly providing proof of the cure to us, all within the thirty (30) day period (or ten (10) day period, as applicable).
all rights granted in this Agreement will automatically terminate without notice to you

we will have the right to terminate this Agreement and all rights granted under this Agreement, without affording you any opportunity to cure the default, effective immediately upon the delivery of our written notice to you

payment_terms.value: Initial Franchise Fee is payable in full on the day you sign this Agreement, or a portion on that day with the remainder plus interest under the Promissory Note; Royalty Fee is the greater of 20% of Gross Revenues on initial-term policies or the monthly Minimum Royalty ($600 for months six to eighteen and $1,000 for the remainder of the term), and 50% of Gross Revenues on policies in their renewal terms and re-writes; Marketing Contribution of up to 2% of Gross Revenues per Month is payable as provided in Section 4.3; you agree to establish electronic funds transfer and sign the ACH authorization; we pay Net Revenues monthly on the 25th; interest on the overdue amount is 18% per annum.
evidence: You agree to pay us an initial franchise fee in the amount set out in the Declarations Page attached as Exhibit A (the "Initial Franchise Fee").
You may pay to us the Initial Franchise Fee, in full, on the day that you sign this Agreement

You may elect to pay to us a portion of the Initial Franchise Fee on the day that you sign this Agreement in the amount set out in the Declarations Page attached as Exhibit A, and to pay to us the remaining portion of the Initial Franchise Fee, with interest, pursuant to the terms and conditions of the promissory note attached to this Agreement as Exhibit I (the "Promissory Note").
The Royalty Fee will be the following amounts: (a) the greater of (i) twenty percent (20%) of Gross Revenues on insurance policies in their initial term, or (ii) the Minimum Royalty (defined below)

(b) fifty percent (50%) of Gross Revenues on policies in their renewal terms and policies written for existing customers on the same risk profile within a one-year period of the cancellation of their existing policy (also known as "re-writes").

The term "Minimum Royalty" means a minimum monthly Royalty Fee payment, beginning six (6) months after the Commencement Date, in the following amounts: Number of Months following the Commencement Date Amount of Monthly Minimum Royalty Six (6) to Eighteen (18) Six Hundred Dollars ($600) Nineteen (19) and for the remainder of the term of this Agreement One Thousand Dollars ($1,000)

For each Month during the term of this Agreement, you agree to contribute an amount up to two percent (2%) of Gross Revenues to be allocated in the manner described in Section 13.2 below (the "Marketing Contribution"). The Marketing Contribution is payable and/or allocated in the manner and at the times required under Section 4.3 above
You agree to establish an arrangement for electronic funds transfer to us, or electronic deposit to us of any payments required under this Agreement.

On the 25th day of each Month, unless this Agreement has been terminated for any reason, we will pay to you the Net Revenues for all policies identified in a commission detail report that we receive from the insurance carrier.

If any payment is overdue, then you agree to pay us, in addition to the overdue amount, interest on the overdue amount from the date it was due until paid, at the rate of eighteen percent (18%) per annum

territory.value: No protected area or territory; the franchise is non-exclusive, and Services may be provided only to customers located in the State in which the Approved Location is situated (unless licensed in another state with our prior written approval).
evidence: You expressly acknowledge and agree that this franchise is non-exclusive, and that this Agreement does not grant or imply any protected area or territory for the Franchised Business.

Unless you become licensed in another state and receive prior written approval from us to offer insurance policies in that state, you may only provide and deliver Services to customers located within the State in which the Approved Location is situated.

alternatives.agreement_date: The agreement would be dated as of the Effective Date entered on the signature page, but that field is blank and no other calendar date exists in the text.
alternatives.expiration_date: The initial term is ten years from the Effective Date (Section 2.1), but no calendar end date is stated.
alternatives.signatories: The only printed name in the execution blocks is P. Ryan Langston (Vice President and General Counsel) on the franchisor side of the state-amendment signature pages; it is preprinted above a blank signature line, so it is not a signature.
alternatives.party_roles: The Franchisee is an unfilled template party (bracketed resident/entity choices, blank state and address); it is included under its defined term rather than omitted.
alternatives.contract_value: The Initial Franchise Fee is the stated consideration but its amount is left blank in Exhibit A; separate figures appear for a $500 relocation fee, $600/$1,000 monthly Minimum Royalty, a $10,000 offering-review fee and insurance limits, none of which is a stated total contract value.
alternatives.termination_notice_period: The 30/10-day notice and cure terms are the base agreement's Section 17.3; Section 17.3 expressly allows a longer period where applicable law requires it. State-specific FDD amendments change these terms for franchisees in those states: California replaces Section 17.3 with a 60-day period to remedy a default after written notice, and Minnesota states 90 days' notice of termination (with 60 days to cure) and 180 days' notice of non-renewal for Minnesota franchisees. The franchisee's state is unfilled in this template.
alternatives.dispute_forum: Section 27.3 requires non-binding JAMS mediation before suit; the agreement contains no arbitration clause, though some state addenda address arbitration sites conditionally.
alternatives.territory: The agreement expressly grants no protected territory; the only stated geographic limit on services is the State of the Approved Location.
